purpose: Adult beginner Mandarin source selection and isolated acquisition validation

entries.name: MIT Learning Chinese: A Foundation Course in Mandarin
entries.edition: Unit 1 dated April 2007, published in Spring 2011 OCW resource
entries.access: Verified course, unit resource, PDF and license HTTP 200
entries.rights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, subject to MIT terms and third-party exclusions
entries.decision: Use one attributed page for local noncommercial acquisition analysis only; no commercial publication, adaptation, redistribution or model training approval

entries.name: ChineseTest HSK
entries.rights: No textbook or syllabus reproduction permission verified
entries.decision: Framework discovery only; no approved syllabus corpus or HSK Standard Course book is claimed

entries.name: Standard Chinese: A Modular Approach
entries.edition: Student Text, Modules 1-2, August 1979, ERIC ED187091
entries.access: Official ERIC catalog HTTP 200 identifies Defense Language Institute, Monterey, CA
entries.rights: Government provenance alone is not recorded as proof that every element is public domain
entries.decision: Verified catalog candidate only; no textbook download or rights approval

entries.name: Wikibooks Chinese (Mandarin)/Greetings
entries.access: Live public HTML and license footer verified
entries.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0, attribution and ShareAlike conditions
entries.decision: Collect as an analysis-only supplemental reference; do not label as an official curriculum

entries.name: Mandarin Corner
entries.access: Live official YouTube oEmbed returns Mandarin Corner author and public video title
entries.rights: Metadata response does not grant transcript, video or reuse rights; official captions download requires editor permission
entries.decision: Metadata integration verified with a current affairs video; that video is not beginner curriculum evidence. Import a creator-authorized beginner transcript when supplied. No transcript has been acquired.

entries.name: Bilibili
entries.access: Developer portal HTTP 200; selected public channel URL returned HTTP 200 CAPTCHA titled 验证码_哔哩哔哩
entries.rights: No platform API credentials, creator authorization or subtitle reuse permission supplied
entries.decision: No channel identity or transcript claimed verified behind the CAPTCHA. Accept authorized creator JSON/SRT/VTT exports; do not bypass the access control.
